title: PokeDiyar
body:
# 🌍 PokéDiyar – Legendary Adventure Minecraft Server # 
PokéDiyar is a Minecraft multiplayer server focused on the Pokémon‑style Pixelmon experience. The server runs on the Pixelmon mod (version 9.3.14) for Minecraft 1.21.1, meaning players play in a world where they can catch, train, and battle Pokémon‑like creatures inside Minecraft — similar to classic Pokémon games but integrated into the Minecraft world.

## 🎮 What You Need to Play ## 
- Minecraft Java Edition (compatible with version 1.21.1)
- NeoForge mod loader for Minecraft 1.21.1
- Pixelmon Mod (v9.3.14) — this adds Pokémon gameplay to Minecraft
- Pixel’s Anti Cheat — likely server protection plugin
- PixelTweaks mod — probably adds custom features or balance tweaks specific to the server experience
  
## ⭐ Server Focus ## 
- Pixelmon gameplay: Explore the world, encounter Pokémon, battle, and progress your team.
- Modded experience: Uses mods that expand Minecraft beyond vanilla survival into a Pokémon RPG style.
- Dedicated server address: mc.pokediyar.com
